title: Product Purchase Input
description: Request-only canonical product selection for buy_products. It shares the strict Product Purchase field shapes but uses Targeting Input so a buyer can distinguish inheritance, replacement, and explicit clearing. Accepted commercial snapshots use product-purchase.json and contain only resolved, non-null effective targeting.

verifier_constraints.direct_purchase_terms: On buy_products, supplied start_time, end_time, measurement_terms, and performance_standards MUST exactly match the selected published offer; omission inherits that offer.

targeting_overlay.description: Per-dimension targeting input. Omission inherits the selected product's configured/default dimension, a non-null value replaces it, and null explicitly suppresses it. A clear cannot remove inherent product scope.

audience_evidence_requirements.title: Product Purchase Audience Evidence Requirements
audience_evidence_requirements.description: Buyer evidence-admissibility policy carried into the accepted purchase snapshot.

measurement_terms.title: Product Purchase Measurement Terms
measurement_terms.description: Published or negotiated billing-measurement and makegood terms for this purchase. Direct buyers may omit this to inherit the product default; accepted proposal snapshots preserve the resolved terms.
